newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil close up, but volume limited.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil close up, but volume limited.

text.p: IPE February Brent crude oil futures closed six cents up on Friday at $23.45 a barrel having drifted sideways for much of the day.
January gas oil futures finished up $1.50 at $217 a tonne but off the day's high of $218.75. Dealers said support came from a cold snap sweeping across much of Europe.
Trading volume was thin with much of the market still on holiday.
Hopes of gains on the back of a strong opening on Nymex crude were shortlived as the energy complex slipped on U.S heating oil.
Brent was unable to capitalise on technical buying in the U.S markets which garnered support from bullish inventory stock data.

The Energy Informatino Administration data showed a 6.1 million draw in American crude stocks to 290.6 million barrels, while API figures pegged the draw at 5.16 million, thinning stocks to 297.5 million barrels.
